name: Triceps Stretch
instructions: Reach your hand behind your head, grasp your elbow and gently pull. Hold for 10 to 20 seconds, then switch sides.
prompt: This is a Triceps Stretch for stretching that uses static force to primarily train the triceps. These are the instructions that a person would receive: "Reach your hand behind your head, grasp your elbow and gently pull. Hold for 10 to 20 seconds, then switch sides."
